name: @local-hosting/spatial-ai
description: Local spatial AI: place-grounded layer on @local-hosting/local-ai (geokit/geotypes linked, not merged).

scripts.pretest: yarn workspace @local-hosting/compose build && yarn workspace @local-hosting/vocab build && yarn build:ui
scripts.eval:geo: yarn workspace @local-hosting/compose build && node --import tsx eval/run-geo-token-eval.ts
scripts.eval:models:live: yarn workspace @local-hosting/compose build && node --import tsx eval/run-live-model-compare.ts
scripts.eval:spatial-chat:live: yarn workspace @local-hosting/compose build && node --import tsx eval/run-spatial-chat-live.ts
scripts.eval:everyday-spatial:live: yarn workspace @local-hosting/compose build && LOCAL_AI_EVAL_CORPUS=everyday-spatial node --import tsx eval/run-spatial-chat-live.ts
scripts.eval:resilience-social-live: yarn workspace @local-hosting/compose build && node --import tsx eval/run-resilience-social-live.ts
scripts.eval:show-translations: yarn workspace @local-hosting/compose build && node --import tsx eval/show-meaningful-translations.ts
